avoid: raster text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, brand marks, diagrams, globe
neon, glowing brains, robots, particles, glass gradients
humiliation, inferiority, racing or comparison between learners
ground shadows or props touching frame edge
claims of guaranteed correctness, proven gains, or Meta endorsement
artDirection.illustrationStyle: flat geometric illustration with soft rounded shapes, warm human confident, restrained matte fills
artDirection.lighting: flat even daylight, matte fills, no shadows, no glow, clean key on pure white
motionPrinciples: one continuous thread: orbit rings unroll into routes into HyperLearn mark into citation connector into agent graph into share branches
SVG-only motion: orthographic rotation, stroke draw-on, dash pulse, parallax truck, no zoom-only shots
character cut-outs only translate and bob, no rigging
nodes light in order, repair loop drawn as possibility only
editorial cuts labelled Sped up where time is compressed
artDirection.perspective: eye-level orthographic, front three-quarter characters at same scale, left-to-right path reading on white plane
artDirection.summary: Warm, human, confident flat geometric system. Vector builds globe, orbits, paths, mark, graph and text. Raster provides only four keyed character cut-outs. A temporary thoughtful pause, never humiliation.

storyboard.motion: SVG orthographic globe spins continuously; rings precess slightly; chips crossfade on behind-globe pass; character layers bob via React translate; parallax between layers, no zoom
storyboard.risk: Avoid tech-over-human; people stay foreground, tools stay as small chips
storyboard.sound: VO: "The world never stops. It keeps changing." Low pulse per chip swap; soft pad enters.
storyboard.visual: Vector globe centered: blue continents, white ocean, hairline graticule. Three tilted vector orbit rings with circular chips riding (book to tablet, compass to map pin, wrench to chip). Four keyed character cut-outs in loose arc foreground with idle bob.

storyboard.motion: SVG rings flatten and unroll into three routes left-to-right; camera trucks right with routes on student pause; dashed gap ends pulse once on VO line
storyboard.risk: Avoid humiliation or race; separate routes, upright thoughtful pause, others continue on own paths
storyboard.sound: VO: "Those who don't learn to adapt risk being left behind. Don't let that happen to you." Pad thins to single held note.
storyboard.visual: Orbits become white-plane routes: curve, stair-step, gentle wave. Worker, teacher, learner walk own routes. Student reaches dashed gap and pauses thoughtful, not defeated.

storyboard.motion: Stroke draw-on across gap into node, two bars rise and snap to mark; dots slide vertically into outline capture; single node pulse
storyboard.onScreenText: Meet HyperLearn + course outline: Lecture 6 / Lecture 7
storyboard.risk: Keep mark as vector reveal, not raster; no extra claims
storyboard.sound: VO: "Meet HyperLearn." Clear reveal tone, soft click per section.
storyboard.visual: Vector curve with node bridges gap, two rounded bars rise to form HyperLearn path-node-bars mark then wordmark. Route dots stack into course outline column.

storyboard.motion: Floating crop of real UI with blue SVG connector line from citation marker to yellow source highlight; typing animation for request; orbit line re-used as connector
storyboard.onScreenText: Change this / This is too complex. Simplify it and give me an interactive example.
storyboard.risk: Show only real source-cited flow with yellow highlight; no correctness guarantee
storyboard.sound: VO: "Your material. Your learning path." Light tick on citation click.
storyboard.visual: Real app crop: reader paragraph with citation marker to source pane PDF region highlighted #FFF3BF. Paragraph selected, typed request for simplification and interactive example.

storyboard.motion: Selected paragraph scales into node; nodes light in order, parallel branches together; Repair dashed loop draws as possibility; evidence line draws from source thumbnail to Verify; cut back to real simplified paragraph and draggable widget
storyboard.onScreenText: LangGraph / Generate -> Verify -> Repair / Source-linked - Versioned - Reversible / if a check fails - max 2 / sentences vs cited source / widget claims recomputed (mathjs) / browser run
storyboard.risk: State verifier as hosted Muse Spark, not open weights; repair as possibility, never failure of this run; no guaranteed correctness
storyboard.sound: VO: "Agents generate, verify, and repair. Simplify an explanation. Explore an interactive example." Soft accents per node, restrained confirmation on Save.
storyboard.visual: Vector graph: Context to parallel Text and Widget to Verify to Save, dashed Repair loop to writers. Source thumbnail feeds Verify. Verifier labelled hosted Muse Spark. Real footage: simplified paragraph with green changed edge and plot widget dragged.

storyboard.motion: Editorial cuts between genuine states labelled Sped up; branch lines draw from app path to three character cut-outs off-frame
storyboard.onScreenText: Not quite + correct version / We adjusted your course - Keep / Undo / Follow your course / Make their own copy / Sped up
storyboard.risk: Show mutations save automatically with Undo and adapt offers Keep / Undo; no learning-gains claim
storyboard.sound: VO: "Practice, adapt your path, and share it with a friend, a colleague, or your students." Three light branch accents.
storyboard.visual: Real practice result Not quite with correct version, then We adjusted your course with Keep / Undo. Real Share dialog. Course path branches to friend, colleague, students.

storyboard.motion: All settles centered; one last node pulse on logo; hold
storyboard.onScreenText: HyperLearn / Keep learning, your way. / hyperlearn.radesh-govind.com / Try it - Explore the code / radeshgovind-2005/meta-hyperlearn / Built during the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon / Built with Meta AI - Powered by Cloudflare

storyboard.sound: VO: "HyperLearn. Keep learning, your way." Resolve chord, fade.
